name: FTC Consumer Sentinel reports by state: fraud, identity theft and imposter scams, 2024 Data Book
description: Reports that consumers made to the U.S. Federal Trade Commission's Consumer Sentinel Network in 2024, by state, DC and Puerto Rico, from the FTC's Consumer Sentinel Network Data Book 2024. Four records per jurisdiction: fraud and other reports and identity theft reports (each with the count, the rate per 100,000 people and the FTC's rank among the 50 states), imposter-scam reports (the share of the state's reports that the FTC prints, with a count and a rate derived from it, flagged as rounded) and fraud reports with the share reporting a loss, the total dollars reported lost and the median loss. Four national records give the whole country. A report is what a consumer or partner told the FTC, not a finding; the state tables leave out reports from state-specific data contributors and reports with no state.
citeAs: Probative Growth. (2026). FTC Consumer Sentinel reports by state: fraud, identity theft and imposter scams, 2024 Data Book (Version 2.0.0) [Data set]. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23963186

distribution.name: consumer-sentinel.csv
distribution.description: Every record, one row each (RFC 4180, UTF-8). Columns are described in README.txt.

distribution.name: consumer-sentinel.json
distribution.description: Every record with its full sources, under a meta envelope (credit line, DOI, license).

distribution.name: consumer-sentinel-values.csv
distribution.description: The columns listed in README.txt as being in consumer-sentinel-values.csv, one row per id, column and value; join it to consumer-sentinel.csv on id.

recordSet.name: consumer-sentinel
recordSet.description: The records of FTC Consumer Sentinel reports by state: fraud, identity theft and imposter scams, 2024 Data Book, one per CSV row.

field.name: jurisdiction
field.description: Two-letter state code, DC, US (federal), ABA, or PLATFORM:<name>

field.name: year
field.description: The calendar year the reports were made (the Data Book year)

field.name: status
field.description: P primary source, S secondary source

field.name: value
field.description: Reports as printed in the data book (imposter-scams is derived)

field.name: text
field.description: The record in one plain-English sentence

field.name: effectiveFrom
field.description: When the fact took effect (YYYY-MM-DD), if known

field.name: effectiveTo
field.description: When it stopped applying; empty while current

field.name: lastChecked
field.description: The day it was last confirmed (YYYY-MM-DD)

field.name: sourceUrls
field.description: Source URLs, in the same order

field.name: confidence
field.description: high, medium or low: computed from status, a second check, age against the refresh cadence and sampling error (rule: /data/#confidence)

field.name: confidenceBasis
field.description: The reasons for the confidence level, in a short phrase
